summary: Expose the read-only original argv[0] value independently of Node's normalized process.argv[0].

semantics.meaning: read-only copy of the original argv[0] used to start Node

caveats: Launchers using exec -a or equivalent can make argv0 differ from execPath.

tests.name: edge may differ from argv zero
tests.expected_behavior: not guaranteed; custom argv[0] launchers can make this false
